segments.text:
V. 6.
That they might have to accuſe him—Either of uſurping the Office of a Judge, if He condemned Her; or, of being an Enemy to the Law, if He acquitted her. Jeſus ſtooping down, wrote with his ſinger on the ground—GOD wrote once in the Old Teſtament; Chriſt once in the New: Perhaps the Words which He afterwards ſpoke, when they continued aſking Him. By this ſilent Action; He
1. ſixt their wandering, hurrying Thoughts, in order to awaken their Conſcience; and
2. ſignified, That He was not then to condemn, but to ſave the World.
